audit.why: EVEN at 5.5/10 matches 52.23% over 1007 games. The lane is decided by one skillshot in each direction: her Tangle-Barbs at 1000 range versus his Shield of Durand at 275, with Justice Punch at 650 as the bridge. The existing 'her early, yours from first item' arc is consistent with that.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is described as 'big AoE burst that roots anyone caught in it' combined with a 'passive stun'. Pop Blossom does not root, and Neeko has no passive stun.
audit.why: enemyKit R: 'After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air, knocking up all nearby enemies. Upon landing, nearby enemies are damaged and stunned. The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.' 120/105/90s, 600 range — knockup then stun. The root is Tangle-Barbs (E). Her passive, Inherent Glamour, is a disguise, not damage or CC: 'Neeko can look like an ally champion or as other units on the map.'
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Pop Blossom, 120s at rank 1, 600 range, knockup into stun, wind-up hidden while disguised. Galio's counter-spike is Justice Punch (11s) plus Hero's Entrance (180s, 4000 range).

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup was absent: Justice Punch's knockup shuts off Pop Blossom.
audit.why: missingInteractions (enemy-dash-deniable) states it directly — 'Your Justice Punch (E) shuts off Neeko's Pop Blossom (R) — hold it for the engage, not the poke.' Pop Blossom has a preparation phase before the leap, and Galio's E knocks up the first champion it hits on an 11s cooldown at rank 1 against her 120s ultimate. That trade of cooldowns is the whole level-6 fight.
audit.corrected: Hold E for her wind-up rather than spending it on poke; 11s against 120s is the best cooldown trade available to you in this lane.
